CRA-MFG_1.title: Product Cybersecurity Risk Assessment
CRA-MFG_1.description: Perform a cybersecurity risk assessment for the product with digital elements (CRA Art. 13(2)).

CRA-MFG_2.title: Manufacturer Due Diligence
CRA-MFG_2.description: Confirm manufacturer due diligence so products meet the essential requirements (Art. 13(1)).

CRA-ESS_1.title: Secure-by-Design Requirements
CRA-ESS_1.description: Design and produce products to meet the essential cybersecurity requirements (CRA Annex I Part I).

CRA-ESS_2.title: Secure Default Configuration
CRA-ESS_2.description: Ship products with a secure-by-default configuration (Annex I Part I, point 3(a)).

CRA-ESS_3.title: No Known Exploitable Vulnerabilities
CRA-ESS_3.description: Place products on the market without known exploitable vulnerabilities (Annex I Part I, point 1).

CRA-VLN_1.title: Vulnerability Handling Policy
CRA-VLN_1.description: Establish a process to identify, document and remediate vulnerabilities (CRA Annex I Part II, points 1 to 2).

CRA-VLN_2.title: Coordinated Vulnerability Disclosure
CRA-VLN_2.description: Adopt a coordinated vulnerability disclosure policy with a contact address (Annex I Part II, point 5).

CRA-VLN_3.title: Security Update Delivery
CRA-VLN_3.description: Provide security updates without delay and free of charge during the support period (Annex I Part II, point 3).

CRA-VLN_4.title: Vulnerability Testing
CRA-VLN_4.description: Test and review the security of the product on a regular basis (Annex I Part II, point 8).

CRA-INC_1.title: Early Warning Notification
CRA-INC_1.description: Send an early warning of an actively exploited vulnerability to the CSIRT and ENISA (CRA Art. 14(2)(a)).

CRA-INC_2.title: Vulnerability Notification
CRA-INC_2.description: Notify the vulnerability or severe incident within the CRA deadline (Art. 14(2)(b)).

CRA-INC_3.title: Final Incident Report
CRA-INC_3.description: Submit the final report on the vulnerability or incident to the authorities (Art. 14(2)(c)).

CRA-INC_4.title: User Notification
CRA-INC_4.description: Inform affected users of the incident and any corrective measures (Art. 14(4)).

CRA-CONF_1.title: Conformity Assessment
CRA-CONF_1.description: Carry out the applicable conformity assessment procedure for the product (CRA Art. 24).

CRA-CONF_2.title: CE Marking and Conformity
CRA-CONF_2.description: Affix the CE marking and draw up the EU declaration of conformity (Art. 27).

CRA-DOC_1.title: CRA Technical Documentation
CRA-DOC_1.description: Compile and keep up to date the technical documentation per CRA Annex VII (Art. 28).

CRA-SUP_1.title: Support Period
CRA-SUP_1.description: Determine and sign off the support period during which security updates are provided (CRA Art. 13(8)).

CRA-SBOM_1.title: Software Bill of Materials
CRA-SBOM_1.description: Produce a software bill of materials covering the top-level dependencies (CRA Annex I Part II, point 1).

CRA-IMP_1.title: Importer Obligations
CRA-IMP_1.description: Verify that imported products meet CRA requirements before placing them on the market (Art. 18).

CRA-IMP_2.title: Distributor Obligations
CRA-IMP_2.description: Check CRA conformity and act on non-conformity when distributing products (Art. 19).

CRA-OSS_1.title: Open-Source Steward Duties
CRA-OSS_1.description: Document the cybersecurity policy expected of open-source software stewards (CRA Art. 24).
